thermal_shock.name: Thermal Shock
thermal_shock.description: Rapid temperature inversion detonates the target and cracks nearby armor.

plague_bloom.name: Plague Bloom
plague_bloom.description: Hexed poison erupts outward, infecting nearby enemies.

fracture.name: Fracture
fracture.description: A disabled, sundered target catastrophically fractures under the next impact.

witchfire.name: Witchfire
witchfire.description: A curse feeds the flame, creating a violet blast that spreads burning.

brittle_venom.name: Brittle Venom
brittle_venom.description: Frozen toxins crystallize in armor and flesh, leaving the victim exposed.
